 }

 }
 function loadStage(){

 }
 function finishSecond(){
  if(ended)return;ended=true;running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);let o=targets[lv-1];state.pdRecord=Math.max(state.pdRecord||0,taps);record.textContent=`BEST ${state.pdRecord}/s`;save();

   const gained=pdStageScore(lv,taps,true);total+=gained;$('#gScore').textContent=total;
   split(o.icon);tone('clear');buzz([30,16,58]);showText(`${taps}회! +${gained}점!`);

  }
 }
 function tick(ts){if(!running)return;let elapsed=ts-start,p=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/1000);fill.style.width=(p*100)+'%';if(elapsed>=1000){finishSecond();return}raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick)}

 };

}

function gpsZones(){
 const z={...GPS_DEFAULTS};
 const cal=state.gpsCalibration||{};
 Object.keys(cal).forEach(k=>{if(cal[k])z[k]=cal[k]});
 return z
}
function rad(d){return d*Math.PI/180}
function metersBetween(a,b){
 const R=6371000,dLat=rad(b.lat-a.lat),dLon=rad(b.lng-a.lng),la1=rad(a.lat),la2=rad(b.lat);
 const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLon/2)**2;
 return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.min(1,Math.sqrt(h)))
}
function pointSegmentDistanceM(p,a,b){
 const lat0=rad((a.lat+b.lat+p.lat)/3),mx=111320*Math.cos(lat0),my=110540;
 const ax=a.lng*mx,ay=a.lat*my,bx=b.lng*mx,by=b.lat*my,px=p.lng*mx,py=p.lat*my;
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,l2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
 if(!l2)return Math.hypot(px-ax,py-ay);
 let t=((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/l2;t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy))
}
function zoneDistanceM(pos,z){
 if(!z)return Infinity;
 if(z.type==='circle')return Math.max(0,metersBetween(pos,{lat:z.lat,lng:z.lng})-(z.radius||0));
 if(z.type==='corridor')return Math.max(0,pointSegmentDistanceM(pos,z.a,z.b)-(z.radius||22));
 return Infinity
}
function gpsAccuracyMargin(pos){const a=Number(pos&&pos.accuracy)||0;return Math.max(0,Math.min(38,a*.62))}

 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);
  prev=ts;

  if(feverTime>0){
   feverTime=Math.max(0,feverTime-dt);
   if(feverTime===0)fever=35;
  }else if(fever>0){
   fever=Math.max(0,fever-dt*1.2);
  }

  phase+=dt*speedNow();

  if(phase>=1){
   combo=0;
   fever=Math.max(0,fever-6);
   grade.textContent='MISS';
   grade.style.color='#d84a43';
   grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');
   tone('bad');
   nextBeat();
  }

  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  ring.style.transform=`scale(${scale})`;
  ring.style.borderColor=feverTime>0?'#ff3ccb':'#ffc928';

  hud();
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 }

 nextBeat();

 let ti=setInterval(()=>{
  t--;
  $('#tm').textContent=t;
  if(t<=0){
   alive=false;
   clearInterval(ti);
   cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
   finish('tteok',score,playTteok,true);
  }
 },1000);

 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;
  clearInterval(ti);
  cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  s.onpointerdown=null;
 };
}

 function crack(progress){

 }
 function showText(t){text.textContent=t;text.classList.remove('show');void text.offsetWidth;text.classList.add('show')}
 function burst(){let r=target.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();for(let i=0;i<20;i++){let b=document.createElement('div');b.className='pdBurst';b.style.left=(r.left-sr.left+r.width/2)+'px';b.style.top=(r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)+'px';b.style.setProperty('--bx',(Math.random()*240-120)+'px');b.style.setProperty('--by',(Math.random()*240-120)+'px');s.appendChild(b);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),520)}}
 function split(icon){
  let base=target.querySelector('.pdIcon');if(base)base.style.opacity='0';target.classList.add('broken');
  let wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='pdSplitWrap';wrap.innerHTML=`<div class="pdHalf left">${icon}</div><div class="pdHalf right">${icon}</div><div class="pdCutFlash"></div>`;target.appendChild(wrap);burst()
 }
 function loadStage(){
  let o=targets[lv-1];taps=0;running=false;ended=false;target.classList.remove('broken');target.innerHTML=`<span class="pdIcon">${o.icon}</span>`;target.style.fontSize=lv===4?'104px':lv===5?'118px':'112px';
  $('#pdLevel').textContent=`LEVEL ${lv}`;need.textContent=`1초 목표: ${o.need}회 이상 · ${o.name} 부수기 · 점수 ×${PD_SCORE_MULT[lv]}`

===== 연타 파괴 챌린지 =====

--- hit 1 @ 1314583 ---

pts>0&&combo>=2){
   showComboBurst(`COMBO ×${combo}`,combo,'combo');
   if(combo%5===0){tone('perfect');buzz([16,7,28])}
  }
  grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');

  impactFx(q);
  level=updateLevel('tteok',score,level);
  nextBeat();
  hud();
 }

 $('#hitBtn').onclick=hit;
 s.onpointerdown=e=>{if(e.target.id!=='hitBtn')hit()};

 function loop(ts){
  if(!alive)return;
  let dt=Math.min(.033,(ts-prev)/1000);
  prev=ts;

  if(feverTime>0){
   feverTime=Math.max(0,feverTime-dt);
   if(feverTime===0)fever=35;
  }else if(fever>0){
   fever=Math.max(0,fever-dt*1.2);
  }

  phase+=dt*speedNow();

  if(phase>=1){
   combo=0;
   fever=Math.max(0,fever-6);
   grade.textContent='MISS';
   grade.style.color='#d84a43';
   grade.classList.remove('show');void grade.offsetWidth;grade.classList.add('show');
   tone('bad');
   nextBeat();
  }

  const scale=2.75-1.75*phase;
  ring.style.transform=`scale(${scale})`;
  ring.style.borderColor=feverTime>0?'#ff3ccb':'#ffc928';

  hud();
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 }

 nextBeat();

 let ti=setInterval(()=>{
  t--;
  $('#tm').textContent=t;
  if(t<=0){
   alive=false;
   clearInterval(ti);
   cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
   finish('tteok',score,playTteok,true);
  }
 },1000);

 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
 cleanup=()=>{
  alive=false;
  clearInterval(ti);
  cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  s.onpointerdown=null;
 };
}

/* POWERDUCK: 1 second mash, objects 1~5 */
function playPowerduck(){
 const s=$('#stage');const targets=[
  {name:'과일',icon:'🍎',need:5},
  {name:'수박',icon:'🍉',need:7},
  {name:'게임패드',icon:'🎮',need:10},
  {name:'큰 오락기',icon:'🕹️',need:13},
  {name:'지구',icon:'🌍',need:16}
 ];
 s.innerHTML=`<div class="powerduckScene"><div class="pdGrid"></div><div class="pdTitle">POWER DUCK<br>1초 연타 파괴 챌린지</div><div class="pdRecord" id="pdRecord">BEST ${state.pdRecord||0}/s</div><div class="pdLevel" id="pdLevel">LEVEL 1</div><div class="pdNeed" id="pdNeed"></div><div class="pdTimer"><div class="pdTimerFill" id="pdFill"></div></div><button class="pdTarget" id="pdTarget"></button><div class="pdStageText" id="pdText"></div><div class="pdCount" id="pdCount">0 연타</div></div>`;
 const PD_SCORE_MULT=[0,1,4,12,40,160];
 const PD_CLEAR_BONUS=[0,0,30,120,500,2000];
 let lv=1,taps=0,total=0,running=false,start=0,raf=null,ended=false;const target=$('#pdTarget'),fill=$('#pdFill'),need=$('#pdNeed'),count=$('#pdCount'),text=$('#pdText'),record=$('#pdRecord');
 function pdStageScore(level,hitCount,cleared=false){
  return Math.max(0,Math.floor(hitCount||0))*(PD_SCORE_MULT[level]||1)+(cleared?(PD_CLEAR_BONUS[level]||0):0)
 }
 function updatePdScorePreview(){
  $('#gScore').textContent=total+pdStageScore(lv,taps,false)
 }
 function crack(progress){
  let c=target.querySelector('.pdCracks');if(!c){c=document.createElement('div');c.className='pdCracks';target.appendChild(c)}c.innerHTML='';let n=Math.floor(progress*7);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let e=document.createElement('div');e.className='pdCrack';e.style.transform=`translate(-50%,-10%) rotate(${i*51-150}deg)`;e.style.height=(45+Math.random()*45)+'px';c.appendChild(e)}
 }
 function showText(t){text.textContent=t;text.classList.remove('show');void text.offsetWidth;text.classList.add('show')}
 function burst(){let r=target.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=s.getBoundingClientRect();for(let i=0;i<20;i++){let b=document.createElement('div');b.className='pdBurst';b.style.left=(r.left-sr.left+r.width/2)+'px';b.style.top=(r.top-sr.top+r.height/2)+'px';b.style.setProperty('--bx',(Math.random()*240-120)+'px');b.style.setProperty('--by',(Math.random()*240-120)+'px');s.appendChild(b);setTimeout(()=>b.remove(),520)}}

 }
